name: Apply Door Frame Finish (Spray Method)
intent: Airless spray finish coat onto primed door frame. One coat per module invocation. Spray produces a glass-smooth laydown — the premium finish look expected at QT4/QT5. Requires wall masking and fixture covers from the setup module.
doctrine: Spray rates ~4x brush rates, matching trim ratio (trim brush 80-90 LF/hr vs spray 380-445 LF/hr = ~5x; frames slightly less because each frame still needs careful trigger control around door opening). Coat 2 faster than coat 1 — same wet-in-wet advantage as trim spray.
